name: ernestdefoe/corkboard
description: Corkboard: project boards inside your Flarum forum. Columns and cards with checklists, due dates, labels, assignees and comments; drag and drop by mouse, touch or keyboard; public, members, team or private boards with per-person roles; My cards and Due soon widgets.

suggest.flarum/tags: Start a discussion from a card in the board's tag
suggest.flarum/mentions: @mention people in card descriptions and comments
suggest.flarum/realtime: Boards update the moment someone moves a card
suggest.ernestdefoe/projects: A board for a project, with its progress on the project page
suggest.ernestdefoe/renown: XP for the people who finish a card
suggest.ernestdefoe/page-builder: My cards, Due soon and Board progress as Page Builder blocks
suggest.fof/forum-widgets-core: My cards and Due soon in FoF's widget sections
suggest.flarum/gdpr: Cards and comments in a member's data export and erasure

scripts-descriptions.test:setup: Sets up a database for use with integration tests. Execute this only once.
